verdict.rationale: Autumn's API covers the core billing lifecycle (check, track, attach and multi-attach, preview, schedules, import, licenses, customer portal), and plan/feature catalog management is code-driven via the `atmn` CLI, including `atmn pull` for products created in the dashboard. An `atmn api` command calls any public endpoint, and an official MCP server exposes billing, plan and log tools, so most dashboard work appears doable programmatically. missing for 10: an explicit documented UI/API parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), independent or hands-on confirmation that no dashboard-only operations exist.
